Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately take these shoes away from young children and contact Reebok to receive a refund.

Description: This recall includes IMI Cornelius Pinnacle FCB frozen carbonate beverage dispensers manufactured between May 2002 and June 2004 with a specific motor drive system. The units contain two or four dispensing valves and come in various color combinations. The names "Cornelius," "FCB," and "Pinnacle" are located on identification plates on the unit's right-side panel. Cornelius is notifying customers of the serial numbers of affected units sold to them.
Title: CPSC, IMI Cornelius Announce Recall to Repair Frozen Carbonate Drink Dispensers
ConsumerContact: Call IMI Cornelius toll-free at (800) 464-4281 between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. CT Monday through Friday or visit the firm's website at www.cornelius.com

Images.Caption: Recalled IMI Cornelius Pinnacle FCB frozen carbonate beverage dispenser

Injuries.Name: IMI Cornelius has received three reports of the nozzle separating. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: IMI Cornelius, of Anoka, Minn.

Retailers.Name: Fast-food restaurants, discount department and convenience stores nationwide, between May 2002 and June 2004.

Hazards.Name: The motor drive can overheat and cause the liquid contents to become hot. If this happens, the dispenser's nozzle can break and expose consumers to the hot liquid, posing a risk of burns.

Remedies.Name: Owners of the drink dispensers should discontinue use and contact IMI Cornelius. The company will send a customer service representative to repair the product free of charge or provide the owners with a modification and instruction kit.

Description: All 2004 Arctic Cat Firecat and Sabercat snowmobiles with red plastic skis are included in this recall. The recalled red plastic skis are part number 1703-500. The model name of the snowmobile is located on either side of the hood. Both the model name and number are in the operator's manual and registration materials.
Title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of Certain 2004 Snowmobiles
ConsumerContact: Stop using the recalled snowmobiles immediately. Call Arctic Cat toll-free at (800) 279-2281 between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. CT Monday through Friday. Please have your snowmobile model name and number with you when you call.

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Arctic Cat Inc., of Thief River Falls, Minn.

Retailers.Name: Arctic Cat dealerships worldwide, from June 2003 through September 2004, for between $5,500 and $8,500.

Hazards.Name: The red plastic skis used on certain 2004 Firecat and Sabercat snowmobiles could crack or break as a result of off-season exposure to ultraviolet sunlight. Ski failure could lead to loss of control, that could result in severe injury or death.

Remedies.Name: Free repair at the local Arctic Cat snowmobile dealer. Registered owners have been notified about this recall by mail.

Description: The recalled kits were sold in a clear plastic package with color or black ink. The black ink kits have model numbers 943264 and 999292 and the color ink kits have model number 999289 printed on the side panel above the UPC code. The two black inkjet sets contain four plastic bottles of black ink, two plastic bottles of cleaning fluid and one toolkit. The color inkjet set contains six plastic bottles of colored ink, two plastic bottles of cleaning solution and one toolkit.
Title: CPSC, NCR Corp. Announce Recall of NCR Universal Inkjet Refill Kits
ConsumerContact: Contact NCR Corp. at (800) 279-0203 between 8 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, e-mail the firm at systemedia.info@NCR.com or visit the firm's website at www.ncr.com

Images.Caption: Recalled NCR Universal Black Inkjet Refill Kit, model 943264
Recalled NCR Universal Black Inkjet Refill Kit, model 999292
Recalled NCR Universal Color Inkjet Refill Kit, model 999289

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: NCR Corp., of Dayton, Ohio

Retailers.Name: Big Lots and Walgreens nationwide, from April 2004 through June 2004, for about $12.

Hazards.Name: The product does not have required child-resistant packaging or required warning labels. The product contains ethylene glycol, posing an ingestion hazard to young children.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately remove the kits out of the reach of young children and return to the store where purchased to receive a refund or a free replacement kit.

Description: The recalled infant carriers were sold under brand name "Baby Björn", which is printed on the front of the carriers and on the black molded plastic back support buckle. Model number 0260 is printed on the care label on the strap of the carrier. The carriers are made of a cotton polyester blend fabric in black with red piping and blue with white piping. "Baby Carrier Active" is written on the packaging and above the warning label on the carrier.
Title: CPSC, Baby Swede, LLC Announce Recall to Repair "Baby Björn" Infant Carriers
ConsumerContact: Consumers should contact Baby Swede, LLC at (866) 424-0200 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, or visit the firm's website at www.babybjorn.com

Images.Caption: Recalled Baby Björn Baby Carrier Active

Injuries.Name: The firm has received 93 reports of the back support buckle detaching from the shoulder straps on the infant carrier. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Baby Swede, LLC, of Cleveland, OH

Retailers.Name: Specialty retail stores, catalogs and internet sites, from September 2003 through August 15, 2004, for about $120.

Hazards.Name: The back support buckle can detach from the shoulder straps, posing a fall hazard to the baby.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the carrier immediately and contact Baby Swede, LLC for instructions on returning the carriers for repair.

Description: The recall includes "Predator 500" ATVs from model years 2003 and 2004 with these model numbers: A03GJ50AA, A03GJ50AB, A03GJ50AS, A03GJ50CA, A04GJ50AA, A04GJ50AB, A04GJ50AC, and A04GJ50AD. The model number is on the lower left frame tube ahead of the engine. "Predator" is prominently displayed on the right and left side of the front cab covering the fuel tank. The ATVs have red, blue, gray or black front and rear cabs.
Title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of ATVs
ConsumerContact: For more information, call Polaris toll-free at (800) POLARIS (765-2747) between 8 a.m. and 12 midnight (ET) seven days a week, or log on to their website at www.polarisindustries.com. Polaris notified consumers directly about this recall.

Injuries.Name: Polaris has received reports of cracked and leaking front brake lines on at least 127 units, with no reported injuries.

Manufacturers.Name: Polaris Industries Inc., of Medina, Minn.

Retailers.Name: Polaris dealers sold these ATVs nationwide, from November 2002 through February 2004, between approximately $6,000 and $6,500.

Hazards.Name: The front brake lines can crack and leak brake fluid, possibly resulting in loss of braking capability. This could result in severe injury or death.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should contact their Polaris dealer to schedule an appointment for free inspection and repair.

Description: The Super Soaker Monster Rocket is composed of a 7-foot inflatable mylar rocket with a plastic and foam fin section. The rocket has a blue and orange launch base with a water pressure tank attached to one leg of the base. The tank, which has an orange cap, is connected to the pump mechanism, which launches the rocket using pressurized air and water. The water toy has the words "Monster Rocket" printed on the body of the rocket.
Title: CPSC, Hasbro Inc. Announce Recall of Monster Rockets
ConsumerContact: Consumers should contact toll-free Hasbro Inc. at (866) 487-4737 anytime or log on to the company's website at www.hasbro.com

Injuries.Name: Hasbro has received four reports of the cap being unexpectedly projected off the rocket, resulting in three injuries, including a slight concussion and a cut requiring stitches. Additionally, Hasbro has received four reports of children being struck by the descending rocket, including three cuts that required stitches.

Manufacturers.Name: Hasbro Inc., of Pawtucket, R.I.

Retailers.Name: Toys 'R' Us, Wal-Mart, Target, KB Toys stores and other toy retailers nationwide sold the rockets from January 2004 through August 2004 for about $30.

Hazards.Name: The cap on the water tank can unexpectedly and forcibly project off when it is quickly unscrewed from the tank, posing a risk of impact injuries to users or bystanders. In addition, the rocket's tail can strike a user or bystander on descent, if the rocket is not fully launched, posing a risk of injury.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the rockets immediately and contact Hasbro to receive a replacement product of equal value.

Description: The 2004 model year four-wheel drive Eiger ATVs are affected by this recall. The model numbers are LT-A400FK4 (for automatic transmission) and LT-F400FK4 (for manual transmission). The ATVs with mislocated welds were produced from May 19 through May 25, 2004. The ATVs are red, yellow, or green.
Title: CPSC, Suzuki Announce Recall of Four-Wheel Drive Eiger ATVs
ConsumerContact: Call 800-444-5077 to find the nearest Suzuki dealer.

Injuries.Name: No injuries reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Suzuki Motor Corporation of Brea, Calif.

Retailers.Name: Suzuki dealers nationwide, from May 28 through August 16, for $5149 (manual transmission) or $5299 (automatic transmission).

Hazards.Name: Mislocated welds securing the upper front suspension arm mounting brackets to the frame. The mounting bracket could break off during riding, reducing rider control and resulting in loss of control of the ATV. Loss of control could result in a crash and severe personal injury or death.

Remedies.Name: Free inspection and repair at dealership. Call your Suzuki dealer for an appointment to have your Eiger ATV inspected and, if necessary, repaired.

Description: The recall includes Lexmark, Dell and IBM brand laser printers. The brand name and model number for the Lexmark and IBM laser printers can be found on the front of the printer. For Dell laser printers, the brand name is on the front of the printer and the model number is inside the front cover. The recall includes the following model numbers: Lexmark E232, E232t, E330, E332n, E332tn; IBM Infoprint 1412, 1412n; Dell 1700 and 1700n.
Title: CPSC, Lexmark International Inc. Announce Recall of Laser Printers
ConsumerContact: For more information, contact Lexmark toll-free at (877) 877-6218 between 9 a.m. and 9 p.m. ET Monday through Friday or between noon and 6 p.m. ET on Saturday; Dell toll-free at Dell (888) 245-3959 between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. CT Monday through Friday; or IBM toll-free at (800) 426-7378 anytime.

Products.Name: Lexmark, Dell and IBM Laser Printers

Injuries.Name: None reported. This recall is being conducted to prevent the possibilities of incidents or injury.

Manufacturers.Name: Lexmark International Inc., of Lexington, Ky.

Retailers.Name: These Lexmark printers were sold directly through distributors, and at electronic, office supply and computer stores. IBM printers were sold directly through authorized distributors and resellers and via IBM's web site. Dell printers were sold directly through the firm's Web site. These laser printers were sold from May 2004 through August 2004 for about $200.

Hazards.Name: These printers can short-circuit, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the laser printer, unplug it, and contact their corresponding laser printer company to register their product to receive a free replacement laser printer.

Description: Halcyon is recalling all stainless steel power inflators. They have a stainless steel oral and power inflate button. Inflators made of plastic are not included in this recall. The repaired inflators have a groove at the base of their retainer nut. The BCs sold with these inflators are black and the Halcyon logo is on the front and collar of the BCs.
Title: CPSC, Halcyon Manufacturing Announce Recall of SCUBA BC Inflators
ConsumerContact: For more information, contact Halcyon Manufacturing at (800) 425-2966 between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday or visit their website at www.halcyon.net

Images.Caption: Recalled Halcyon SCUBA Buoyancy Compensator (BC) Inflator
Recalled Halcyon SCUBA Buoyancy Compensator (BC) Inflator

Injuries.Name: Halcyon has reports of 10 incidents of BCs leaking. No injuries or deaths have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Halcyon Manufacturing, of High Springs, Fla.

Retailers.Name: Dive stores nationwide sold these inflators individually, from October 2003 through May 2004, for about $46. The inflators also were sold as part of BC units ranging from $270 to $600.

Hazards.Name: The SCUBA BC bladder can have a slow leak because of imperfections within the machining of the stainless air barrel of their inflators. This can cause unexpected buoyancy problems with divers, possibly resulting in decompression sickness.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using these BCs immediately and contact Halcyon for information on receiving a free repair.

Description: The recalled 56W AC power adapters were shipped primarily with IBM ThinkPad i Series, 390 and 240 Series, and s Series notebook computers. The adapters have three hollow pins at the AC inlet and part number 02K6549 on a label on the top of the unit. The IBM logo appears on top of the unit. Adapters with solid pins are not included in this recall.
Title: CPSC, IBM Announce Recall of AC Adapters for Notebook Computers
ConsumerContact: Call IBM at (800) 410-5629 between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. ET Monday through Friday or log on to IBM's replacement unit website at www.AdapterProgram.com

Images.Caption: Recalled AC Power Adapters with hollow pins

Injuries.Name: IBM has received six reports of incidents, including some with minor property damage. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Delta Electronics Inc., of Taipei, Taiwan

Retailers.Name: Electronics and computer stores nationwide, the IBM Web site, phone orders, mail-order catalogs, and resellers sold the adapters with the ThinkPad computers, from January 1999 through August 2000. The adapters also were sold as an accessory during that time for about $55.

Importers.Name: International Business Machines (IBM) Corp., of Armonk, N.Y.

Hazards.Name: The adapters can overheat, cause damage to the circuit board and melt through the housing, which poses a fire and electrical shock hazard to consumers.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should unplug the recalled adapters from the wall outlet immediately and contact IBM for a free replacement unit.

Description: The recall includes Oceanic-brand Reliant BC inflators and AERIS-brand AW3 BC inflators. The Oceanic Reliant-type inflators have three flow-through holes in the hand grip of the lower inflator mechanism. The AERIS AW3 inflator has one flow-through hole in the hand grip of the lower inflator mechanism.
Title: CPSC, Pelagic Pressure Systems Announce Recall of SCUBA BC Inflators
ConsumerContact: Call Pelagic toll-free at (888) 854-4960 between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, send an email to service@oceanicusa.com or info2@diveaeris.com, or write to Pelagic Pressure Systems, 2002 Davis Street, San Leandro, CA 94577.

Products.Name: Oceanic-brand Reliant Buoyancy Compensator (BC) Inflators and AERIS-brand AW3 BC Inflators

Images.Caption: Recalled Oceanic-brand Buoyancy Compensator (BC) with Reliant Inflator
Recalled AERIS-brand Buoyancy Compensator (BC) with AW3 Inflator

Injuries.Name: Pelagic has received eight reports of the buttons sticking. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Pelagic Pressure Systems, of San Leandro, Calif.

Retailers.Name: Authorized Oceanic dealers sold BCs fitted with Reliant inflators nationwide, from February 2004 through June 2004, for between $320 and $550. Authorized AERIS dealers sold BCs fitted with AW3 inflators, from May 2004 through June 2004, for between $400 and $560.

Hazards.Name: Inflator buttons can stick, which can cause uncontrolled inflation of the BC. This could cause divers to ascend too fast, resulting in decompression sickness as well as the danger of an embolism.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using BCs fitted with the recalled inflators immediately and take them to any authorized Oceanic or AERIS dealer to get a free repair.

Description: The recall involves Leoch-brand scooters that were also sold under the names "E-Scooter" and "Red Dragon." The scooters have a seat, two wheels and footrests on each side. A sticker on the left footrest reads, "E-Scooter." On the right footrest there is a sticker with a horse-head image. A serial number is printed underneath the left footrest. The affected scooter's model number is DK24250-3.
Title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Electric Scooters
ConsumerContact: Call Target toll-free at (800) 440-0680 between 7 a.m. and 6 p.m. CT Monday through Friday, or visit the firm's website at www.target.com

Products.Name: Leoch Electric Scooters (also known as "Red Dragon" and "E-Scooter")

Images.Caption: Recalled Leoch Electric Scooter (also known as "Red Dragon" and "E-Scooter")

Injuries.Name: Target has received two reports of the scooters catching fire. There have been 13 reports of scooters starting and/or moving on their own. One person reported receiving scratches as a result. There have also been five reports of property damage, including two reports of the scooters causing house fires.

Manufacturers.Name: Leoch E-Vehicle Ltd.

Retailers.Name: Target stores nationwide, from February 2003 through June 2004, for about $200.

Importers.Name: Target Corp., of Minneapolis, Minn.

Hazards.Name: Improper wiring can cause a short circuit, posing a fire hazard in the scooter. In addition, inadequate insulation may expose electrical wiring, which poses a shock hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the scooters immediately and return them to any Target store for a full refund.

Description: The "C"-shaped pillows are about 36 inches long, 10 inches wide and 5 inches deep. There is a 100 percent cotton hypoallergenic cover of various colors and prints over the white pillow. The outer cover is removable. The whole pillow is washable. The fabric tag on the pillow reads, "Boston Billows, Inc."
Title: CPSC, Boston Billows Inc. Announce Recall of Nursing Pillows
ConsumerContact: Consumers can contact the Boston Billows Inc. at (877) 274-4606 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday.

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Boston Billows Inc., of Nashua, N.H.

Retailers.Name: Hospitals and independent specialty stores, from February 2000 through December 2003, for between $34 and $38.

Hazards.Name: If infants are placed on these pillows and left unattended, there is a risk of suffocation. Infant pillows and cushions are banned under the Federal law. Infant pillows have a flexible fabric covering, are loosely filled with plastic beads, easily flattened, intended for use by infants under 1 year old, and capable of conforming to the body or face of an infant.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using these pillows immediately and contact the firm for information on receiving a refund. Update: A December 19, 2008 decision by the Commission to exempt this product has superseded this recall action. As a result, this recall action is no longer in effect.

Description: The Lascal "Buggy Board" is a wheeled board that attaches to a stroller or baby carriage, allowing an older child to stand on the board and ride behind the stroller between the arms of a parent or caregiver. The product comes in black, blue, red and techno styles, and has the words "Buggy Board" printed on the top center of the board, with the name "Lascal" molded into the plastic on the bottom center of the board. Buggy Boards with orange connecting pins are not included in the recall.
Title: CPSC, Regal Lager Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Stroller Attachments
ConsumerContact: Call Regal Lager Inc. at (877) 242-5676 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, or log on to the company's website at www.regallager.com

Images.Caption: Recalled Lascal "Buggy Board" attached to stroller

Injuries.Name: Regal Lager Inc. has received two reports of the Buggy Board disengaging from a stroller or carriage, resulting in falls to children. One minor injury was reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Regal Lager Inc., of Kennesaw, Ga.

Retailers.Name: Specialty retail stores, catalogs and internet sites, from January 2003 through July 2004, for about $88.

Hazards.Name: The Buggy Board's red connecting pins can break, causing the board to partially detach from the stroller or carriage, posing a fall hazard to the user.

Remedies.Name: The manufacturer is providing free repair kits to consumers, consisting of orange replacement pins for these Buggy Boards.

Description: The pillows have a blue or peach-colored print fabric showing yellow moons, hearts and stars, or tan and blue teddy bears. The log-shaped pillows measure about 5 feet in length. "THERALINE," "THE BIG V" and "Finest Micropearl Filling" are written on a fabric tag sewn on the pillow.
Title: CPSC, Theraline Inc. Announce Recall of Maternity and Nursing Pillows
ConsumerContact: Consumers can contact Theraline Inc. at (866) 843-7254 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday.

Products.Name: Big V Maternity and Nursing Pillows

Images.Caption: Recalled Big V Maternity and Nursing Pillow

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Theraline Inc., of Wendell, Mass.

Retailers.Name: Independent specialty stores sold the pillows, from June 2003 through May 2004, for about $60.

Hazards.Name: If infants are placed on these pillows and left unattended, there is a risk of suffocation. Infant pillows and cushions are banned under the Federal law. Infant pillows have a flexible fabric covering, are loosely filled with plastic beads, easily flattened, intended for use by infants under 1 year old, and capable of conforming to the body or face of an infant.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using these pillows immediately and contact the firm for information on receiving a refund.

Description: The Aviva Astroslide 17048 is a large, inflatable water slide measuring 5 feet high and 9 feet long. It is used for sliding into a pool or lake. "AVIVA AstroSlide" is written on the sides of the slide. The slide is green with orange handles.
Title: CPSC, Aviva Sports Announce Recall to Repair Astroslide Water Slides
ConsumerContact: For additional information, contact Aviva Sports by calling collect at (573) 346-1402 or email the firm at sales@goaviva.com

Injuries.Name: Aviva has received one report of a child being tangled on the rope in the water. No injuries have been reported.

Retailers.Name: Sporting good stores nationwide, from January 2004 through May 2004, for about $99.

Distributors.Name: Aviva Sports, of Osage Beach, Mo.

Hazards.Name: These water slides have an excessive length of rope attached to the safety mat, that presents a risk of entanglement in the water. This poses a drowning hazard to users.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using these slides and contact Aviva Sports to request a free repair kit. After making the repair, consumers can resume using the product.

Description: The SlideCarver is a three-wheeled scooter which is designed to be steered both in the front and back. The steering design allows riders to shift weight and change direction while maintaining control. It has twin-disc brakes, and wide tires equipped with wear indicators. The SlideCarver stands 39.5 inches high by 20 inches wide, has a 26.5-inch wheelbase, weighs approximately 26.5 pounds, and can be folded. "BMW" and "SlideCarver" are written on the underside of the rider platform of these scooters.
Title: CPSC, BMW Announce Recall of SlideCarver Scooters
ConsumerContact: For more information, contact BMW at (800) 831-1117 between 9 a.m. and 9 p.m. ET Monday through Friday.

Injuries.Name: BMW has received one report of a scooter front column breaking, causing a rider to fall and suffer minor injuries.

Manufacturers.Name: BMW of North America, LLC, of Woodcliff Lake, N.J.

Retailers.Name: BMW dealerships and on the firm's Web site, from December 2003 through July 2004, for about $700.

Hazards.Name: The front column of the scooter does not meet impact resistance standards. The handlebar column can break if the scooter hits an object, which can cause the rider to fall and suffer injuries.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should return the SlideCarver scooters to any BMW dealership or contact the firm for information on returning the scooter to receive a refund. Additionally, consumers will receive a $200 gift certificate for BMW lifestyle merchandise.

Description: The recall includes electric coil top freestanding ranges and wall ovens. The coil ranges are 30 inches wide with controls in the rear. The wall ovens include the 27- and 30-inch models, with the lower oven controlled by a knob and not self-clean. The upper oven is self-clean. The following models are included in this recall: Freestanding Coil Ranges Hotpoint Brand RB757BH/WH/CH RB536WH/CH RB526H RB525BH/H General Electric Brand JBS27BH/WH/CH/SH JBS03BH/H JBS07H JBP21BH/WH Americana Brand ABS300J Kenmore Brand 22-91112/4 22-62781 Double Wall Ovens Kenmore Brand 22-47722/4/9 General Electric Brand JTP28B/W/S/C JKP28B/W/C
Title: CPSC, GE Announce Recall of Ranges and Wall Ovens
ConsumerContact: Consumers should call the GE Recall Hotline at (800) 326-1076 anytime to see if their range or wall oven is included in this recall and arrange for the free repair.

Products.Name: General Electric, Hotpoint, Kenmore, and Americana brand freestanding electric ranges and double wall ovens

Injuries.Name: There have been no incidents reported. This recall is being conducted to prevent the possibility of injuries.

Manufacturers.Name: General Electric Appliances Co., of Louisville, Ky.

Retailers.Name: Appliance retail outlets and builder distributors nationwide sold the ranges, from June 2004 through July 2004, for between $250 and $500, and the wall ovens, from April 2004 through July 2004, for between $950 and $1500.

Hazards.Name: The ranges and wall ovens have faulty wiring, which can melt and cause the oven to short circuit. The appliance can then stop working and pose a shock hazard to consumers.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the appliances immediately and contact GE to schedule a repair at no charge.

Description: The recall involves Whirlpool and KitchenAid brand freestanding ranges, double ovens, and oven-microwave combination products with the following model and serial numbers: Brand Product Model Numbers Serial Number Range Whirlpool Oven-microwave combination GSC XR15 - XR25 Whirlpool Double wall oven RBD XR15 - XR25 KitchenAid Oven-microwave combination KEHC KEMC XR15 - XR25 KitchenAid Electric free standing range KERA2 KERI2 RR15 - RR25 The model and serial numbers are located on a label inside the door of the units.
Title: CPSC, Whirlpool Announce Recall of Cooking Products
ConsumerContact: Consumer should call Whirlpool toll-free at (866) 770-6751 between 8 a.m. and 9 p.m. ET Monday through Friday or between 8 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. ET on Saturday to schedule the free repair.

Products.Name: Freestanding ranges, double ovens, and oven-microwave combinations

Injuries.Name: Whirlpool has received no reports of incidents. This recall is being conducted to prevent the possibility of injuries.

Manufacturers.Name: Whirlpool Corp., of Benton Harbor, Mich.

Retailers.Name: Department, mass merchandise and appliance stores nationwide, as well as home builders, sold the recalled units, from April 2004 through July 2004. The Whirlpool Oven-Micro Combo sold for between $2200 and $2720, the Whirlpool Double Wall Oven for between $930 and $1350, the KitchenAid Oven-Micro Combo for between $2300 and $3740 and the KitchenAid Free Standing Range for between $850 and $1230.

Hazards.Name: All of the appliances use faulty wiring, which can overheat, melt through the insulation and cause a short circuit. They may pose a shock hazard to consumers, if the appliance is not properly grounded.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the product, unplug it by shutting off the fuse or circuit breaker, and contact Whirlpool for a free repair.

Description: The recalled batteries are used with the 15-inch PowerBook G4 (Aluminum) laptop computer. The batteries, which contain cells manufactured during the last week of December 2003 only, have the model number A1045 and serial numbers that begin with HQ404, HQ405, HQ406, HQ407, or HQ408. The model and serial numbers can be found on a label on the bottom of the battery. The battery is approximately 4 inches long, 3 inches wide, and ¾ inches tall. No other PowerBook or iBook batteries are involved in this recall.
Title: CPSC, Apple Announce Recall of PowerBook Computer Batteries
ConsumerContact: Contact Apple at (800) 275-2273 between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. CT Monday through Sunday or log on to Apple's website at www.apple.com/support/powerbook/batteryexchange

Products.Name: Rechargeable batteries used in 15-inch Apple PowerBook G4 computers

Images.Caption: Recalled battery used in 15-inch PowerBook G4 laptop

Injuries.Name: Apple has received four reports of batteries overheating, though no injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Apple Computer Inc., of Cupertino, Calif.
LG Chem Ltd., of South Korea

Retailers.Name: National and regional resellers, catalogers, and Apple's online and retail stores sold the computers with the batteries, from January 2004 through August 2004, for between $2000 and $2600. The batteries also were sold separately for about $130.

Hazards.Name: An internal short can cause the battery cells to overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled batteries immediately and contact Apple to arrange for a replacement battery, free of charge.

Description: The recalled product is a red folding chair with a metal frame and vinyl padded seat back and base. The chair was sold as a part of a five-piece juvenile table furniture set with a green table, blue chair, yellow chair, green chair, and red chair. Only the red chairs with model numbers 11-88-3E1 and 11-88S3E1 and date codes H3, B4, D4 or E4 printed underneath the seat bottom are included in the recall. "Meco" or "Samsonite" brand names are also printed on the seat label.
Title: CPSC, Meco Corp. Announce Recall of Red Chairs from Children's Furniture Sets
ConsumerContact: Call Meco at (800) 251-7558 between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. ET Monday through Friday or visit Meco's website at www.meco.net

Products.Name: Kid's Essentials Five-Piece Folding Furniture Set

Images.Caption: Recalled Kid's Essentials Five-Piece Folding Furniture Set
Recalled folding chair showing location of model numbers and date codes

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Meco Corp., of Greeneville, Tenn.

Retailers.Name: Furniture and wholesale club stores nationwide, from July 2003 through June 2004, for between $25 and $40.

Hazards.Name: The red paint on the chair contains excessive lead levels, posing a lead poisoning hazard to young children.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using this red chair immediately and contact the firm for instructions on returning the red chair and receiving a free replacement chair.

Description: These Schwinn-brand Toddler Bicycle Helmets have "SCHWINN" written on the back of the helmets. A white label inside the helmets reads, "Lot# 791913." This number is followed by a date from "12-01-03" through "5-15-04." This label also contains the model number SK103, SK107 or SK108.
Title: CPSC, PTI Sports Inc. Announce Recall of Schwinn Toddler Bicycle Helmets
ConsumerContact: For more information, contact PTI Sports at (800) 515-0074 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday.

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: PTI Sports Inc., of Rancho Cucamonga, Calif.

Retailers.Name: Wal-Mart, Target, Academy and Mills Fleet and Farms stores nationwide, from January 2004 through July 2004, for between $17 and $20.

Hazards.Name: The helmets do not comply with impact testing requirements in the Consumer Product Safety Act.

Remedies.Name: Return the recalled helmet to the store where purchased for a replacement or refund. Consumers also can send the helmet back to the manufacturer.

Description: This recall involves "Windsor" style arm chairs. The chairs measure 40 inches high by 21 inches wide. Made of black wood, the chairs have 9 metal spindles across the rounded back.
Title: CPSC, American Signature Announce Recall of Dinette Chairs
ConsumerContact: For more information, consumers should contact the store manager of their local American Signature or Value City Furniture store.

Injuries.Name: American Signature has received two reports of chairs collapsing, including one report of a consumer who fell and bruised her legs.

Manufacturers.Name: American Signature Inc., of Columbus, Ohio

Retailers.Name: American Signature Home and Value City Furniture stores in the Midwest and South during the month of April 2004, for about $70 a pair.

Hazards.Name: The stretch bar, which connects to the chair's legs, can detach during normal use, causing the user to fall and suffer injuries.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should contact the store where the chairs were purchased to arrange for a pickup of the original chair in exchange for a replacement chair.

Description: The "GET-GO" and "LITTLE GET-GO" children's athletic shoes come in various color combinations and were sold in toddler and pre-school sizes 2C through 3Y. The Nike Swoosh symbol is on the outside and sole of the shoe. All shoes close with a strap. The style name "GET-GO" or "LITTLE GET-GO" is written on the shoe box. The recalled shoes have one of the following six-digit numbers on a label inside the shoe just above the UPC code: 308638, 308639, 308642 and 308647. Only these style numbers are included in this recall.
Title: CPSC, NIKE Announce Recall of Children's Athletic Shoes
ConsumerContact: For more information, call Nike at (800) 344-6453 anytime or visit the Nike website at www.nikebiz.com

Products.Name: Nike™ Get-Go and Little Get-Go Children's Athletic Shoes

Images.Caption: Recalled Nike™ Little Get-Go Children's Athletic Shoe

Injuries.Name: Nike has received three reports of heel tabs separating from shoes. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Nike USA, Inc., of Beaverton, Ore.

Retailers.Name: Nike stores, major athletic shoe stores, independent shoe stores and children's stores nationwide, from June 2004 through August 2004, for between $35 and $45.

Hazards.Name: The 1.5-inch to 1.75-inch rubber tab at the top of the heel can detach from the shoe, posing a choking hazard to young children.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately take the recalled shoes away from young children and contact Nike to receive a refund voucher.

Description: The scented candle is housed in a clear glass holder and has a crumbled appearance with color variations. It contains slices of dried apple and cinnamon sticks in the wax. The candle is 3 inches in diameter and 3.5 inches high. "Kitchen Krumblers" is labeled at the base of the candle. The candle was sold separately or in a set with another candle not involved in this recall.
Title: CPSC, Seventh Avenue Inc. Announce Recall of Kitchen Krumblers Candle
ConsumerContact: For more information, contact Country Door at (800) 659-6473 between 8 a.m. and 12 a.m. CT.

Images.Caption: Recalled Kitchen Krumblers Apple Cinnamon Candle

Injuries.Name: Three reports have been received of a candle flaring up, breaking the glass, and spreading fire. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Mostly Memories Inc., of Ozark, Mo.

Retailers.Name: The Country Door Catalog and Web site, from February 2004 through May 2004, for about $12.

Hazards.Name: The dried apples and cinnamon in the candle can ignite, causing a flare up and breaking the glass, posing a fire hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the candle and return it to Country Door for a refund.

Description: The recalled Belkin OmniGuard Rackmount UPS units are used to provide voltage regulation, surge suppression, and back-up power for electronic equipment. The Belkin OmniGuard Rackmount UPS units are black with a silver/gray panel on the front. Recalled units are the OmniGuard 1100 (Model no. F6C110-RKM-2U), OmniGuard 1500 (Model no. F6C150- RKM-2U), OmniGuard 2300 (Model no. F6C230-RKM-2U), and OmniGuard 3200 (Model no. F6C320-RKM-3U). The model number and model type can be found on a label on the rear of the unit.
Title: CPSC, Belkin Corp. Announce Recall of Rackmount Uninterruptible Power Supplies
ConsumerContact: Call Belkin Customer Service Center toll-free at (800) 223-5546 ext. 2064 between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. PT Monday through Friday to arrange for a free replacement. Consumers can also log on to the company's website at www.belkin.com for additional shipping information.

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Belkin Corp., of Compton, Calif.

Retailers.Name: Electronics distributors and retailers, from September 2003 through June 2004, for between $560 and $1360.

Hazards.Name: The UPS outputs were wired incorrectly, creating a reverse polarity configuration and a potential electrical shock hazard to consumers.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the unit and contact Belkin Corp. for a free replacement unit.

Description: These down-rod-mount, dual-motor, 36-inch ceiling fans were sold in chrome, stone white, brush nickel, polished brass, antique brass, or weathered patina finishes. Model number 355-6645 is printed on the box and on a label located on the central housing of the ceiling fan. The brand names of the fans are "Aire Tek" and "Turn-of-the- Century Apollo Series" which is written on the packaging only. A label located on the central housing of the ceiling fan displays the File Number "E215078," the UL Listing Mark, and the model number 355-6645. Vaxcel had previously recalled the same model fan sold under the "Aire Tek" brand name.
Title: CPSC, Vaxcel International Co. Ltd. Announce Second Recall of Ceiling Fans
ConsumerContact: Call Vaxcel at (800) 482-9235 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. CT Monday through Friday.

Images.Caption: Recalled "Turn-of-the- Century Apollo Series" ceiling fan with light

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Vaxcel International Co. Ltd., of Glendale Heights, Ill.

Retailers.Name: Menards stores nationwide, between January 2002 and May 2002, for between $350 and $450.

Hazards.Name: These ceiling fans were assembled without the proper wire insulation sleeving, which could result in exposed wiring. Consumers could receive an electrical shock during installation or removal.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should contact Vaxcel to verify if they have one of the recalled ceiling fans and to receive a free replacement ceiling fan if they do. To avoid the risk of shock while checking or removing a recalled fan, consumers should turn off the power source to the fan. Consumers are encouraged to use a professional electrician. Vaxcel will reimburse consumers up to $75 for charges incurred in removing recalled fans.

Description: The recalled "10,000 Lux Light Box" produces light to simulate natural sunlight. The units, which are white with a translucent hinged door, measure 24 inches high, 12 ½ inches wide, and 3 ¾ inches deep. Some of the recalled light boxes may have a small label on the top of the unit with the name "Nu-Yu Light." Only the "10,000 Lux Light Box" sold by Natural Options is recalled.
Title: CPSC, OTT-LITE Technology Announce Recall of "10,000 Lux Light Box" That Simulates Natural Sunlight
ConsumerContact: Call OTT-LITE Technology toll-free at (866) 421-5181 between 9 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. (ET), Monday through Friday or visit the OTT-LITE website at www.ott-lite.com to arrange for return of the product and a full refund.

Injuries.Name: Five customers reported light boxes producing smoke and returned their light boxes with burn marks and melted plastic in the socket area. No injuries or property damage have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: OTT-LITE Technology of Tampa, Florida

Retailers.Name: Natural Options' Web site and mail order catalog sold the light boxes, from November 2002 through June 2004, for about $400.

Distributors.Name: Natural Options Inc. of Nashotah, Wis.

Hazards.Name: Overheating around the socket (where the bulb fits into the light box) can result in melted plastic and smoke, posing a possible fire and burn hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled "10,000 Lux Light Box" immediately, unplug it, and return the product to OTT-LITE Technology for a full refund.

Description: The recalled models of wooden bunk beds are: Twin/Twin #1000; Twin/Double #2000; and Loft Bunk #3000. There are no model numbers on the bunk beds, but the manufacturer's label is located on the inside of the upper bunk's end structure. The Twin/Twin #1000 has top and bottom bunks of equal size. The Twin/Double #2000 has a twin top bunk and a double bottom bunk that is 15 inches wider. The Loft Bunk #3000 has the bottom bunk perpendicular to the top bunk, making an "L" shape.
Title: CPSC, PJ Sleep Shop Announce Recall to Repair Bunk Beds
ConsumerContact: To get a free repair kit, contact PJ Sleep Shop or Banner Furniture (depending upon which dealer sold the bunk bed). Although repair kits are not available on-line, consumers in Oregon and Washington state can call PJ Sleep Shop at (888) 232-5225 between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, and from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturday.

Products.Name: Wooden bunk beds: Twin/Twin, Twin/Double, and Loft Bunk

Images.Caption: Recalled Loft Bunk wooden bunk bed

Injuries.Name: None reported.

Manufacturers.Name: PJ Sleep Shop of Portland, Ore.

Retailers.Name: PJ Sleep Shop in Portland, Oregon, and Banner Furniture stores in Portland and Hillsboro, Oregon, between June 1, 2000, and February 29, 2004. Model #1000 sold for about $199, Model #2000 sold for about $325, and Model #3000 sold for about $349.

Hazards.Name: These bunk beds have gaps between parts of the upper bunk end structure that violate the federal safety standard, because they pose entrapment or strangulation hazards to children. The spaces exceed that allowed by the federal bunk bed safety standard, which is designed to protect children from entrapment and strangulation.

Remedies.Name: Stop using the recalled bunk beds and get a free repair kit from the manufacturer to cover up the entrapment hazards. Consumers can install the repair kit easily at home.

Description: The recalled toy is an 11-inch purple stuffed frog with a green chin, belly, hands and feet. The stuffed frog has the word "BRAVE" sewn in purple letters onto the underside of its right foot.
Title: CPSC, Determined Productions Announce Recall of Plush Toys Sold at Kohl's Department Stores
ConsumerContact: Call Determined Productions toll-free at (877) 925-0660 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. PT Monday through Friday or email the firm at Normamail@dpisf.com. Consumers also can visit Kohl's website at www.kohls.com

Injuries.Name: Determined Productions has received one report of seam breakage on the toy, resulting in a child choking on the plastic pellets. The child was taken to the hospital and released without any injury, after a procedure to look for aspirated beads.

Manufacturers.Name: Determined Productions Inc., of Larkspur, Calif.

Retailers.Name: Kohl's Department Stores sold the toys exclusively throughout July 2004 for about $5.

Hazards.Name: The seams in the toy can tear open and expose small plastic pellets, posing a choking or aspiration hazard to young children who mouth the pellets.

Remedies.Name: Consumers are advised to stop using the toy immediately and contact Determined Productions or stop at a local Kohl's Department Stores to receive a refund or store credit.

Description: The recalled toy is a blue wooden ball with six holes located equally around the ball. Each hole contains a small wooden head with a smiling face in various colors.
Title: CPSC, HearthSong Announce Recall of Children's Toy Balls
ConsumerContact: For additional information, call HearthSong toll-free at (888) 623-6557 anytime or log onto the company's website at www.hearthsong.com

Injuries.Name: The firm has received one report of a child placing the small wooden head in its mouth. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: HearthSong Inc., of Madison, Va.

Retailers.Name: Exclusively through HearthSong's catalog and Web site, from October 2001 through March 2004, for about $10.

Hazards.Name: The wooden rings on the holes of the product may crack, allowing the small wooden heads to fall out and pose a choking hazard to young children.

Remedies.Name: HearthSong will notify all known purchasers by mail regarding a refund and a discount towards the next purchase.

Description: The recall involves 13 plush Pokémon characters. All recalled toys have a sewn-in label reading "TOMY." There also is a production code on the toy's label that begins with a letter and is followed by two numbers. The following production codes are included in the recall: A04, B04, C04, D03, D04, E03, E04, F03, F04, G03, G04, H03, I03, J03, K03, and L03. Any production code containing an "S" is not part of this recall.
Title: CPSC, TOMY Company Announce Recall of Pokémon Plush Toys
ConsumerContact: Call TOMY Company at (800) 691-8055 between 9 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. ET Monday through Friday or visit the company's Web site at www.tommy.com

Products.Name: Pokémon plush dolls, beanbags, and key chains

Images.Caption: Recalled Jirachi Medium Plush, #2714 - measures about 9 inches tall; it is pale blue with a yellow star-shaped head and three turquoise strips of fabric
Recalled Charizard Medium Plush, #2951 - measures about 8 inches tall and is about 9 inches long; it is orange with a yellow stomach, and blue inside its wings
Recalled Venusaur Medium Plush, #2952 - measures about 6 inches tall and 7 inches long; it is turquoise with a pink flower on its back with green leaves
Recalled Blastoise Medium Plush, #2953 - measures about 8 inches tall and is 6½ inches wide; it is light blue with a cream stomach and a brown shell
Recalled Treecko Plush Keychain, #2643 - measures about 5½ inches long; it is light green with dark green tails, and a red stomach
Recalled Mudkip Plush Keychain, #2644 - measures about 4 inches tall and 4 inches long; it is dark blue with a light blue stomach and tail and orange cheeks
Recalled Torchic Plush Keychain, #2645 - measures about 4 inches long; it is bright orange with lighter orange on its head and wings
Recalled Plusle/Minun Plush set, #2960 - each measures about 8½ inches tall, both are cream colored, one with red ears, cheeks, and tail, and the other has blue ears, cheeks, and tail
